description: 'Granola rejected this key' gives no cause and no next step. A Pro-plan user can never succeed and the alternative (live questions) is not mentioned.
expected: Message that names the likely cause or points to the live-questions route, or hides the key card for plans without API access.
suggested_fix: Decide copy per plan S6 (granola.md says the card explains nothing on free plan); keep copy minimal.

description: The rejection line is gray 13 px, not destructive red, so it reads as a hint, not an error. Contrast of gray on black is about 6:1 which passes, but it is the weakest element on the screen.
expected: Destructive color, 15-17 px footnote per iOS.
suggested_fix: Use the destructive token for the line.

description: Offline, rate limited (429) and needs_reconnect later are not drawn on mobile (web draws Rate limited). Revoked key later: user sees it only by opening Integrations, no badge.
expected: Mobile states for network failure and revoked key.
suggested_fix: Draw or specify; link to JF-3 for where the surface lives.

description: The key field is read-only dots after rejection in the web version and editable here; with dots the user cannot see whether the paste was truncated. No clear-field control.
expected: Reveal or clear control for secure field.
suggested_fix: Native SecureField is fine; consider clearing on focus.
